locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: semper aut frequentius eodem modo operantur, ut consequantur id quod est optimum
interpretation: Reading A: an observation (videmus) about natural bodies as such, so stated for every natural body, together with their existence. It is what the conclusion's omnes res naturales needs. Stronger than a literal reading of aliqua (sibling reading B).
